# Pixel Tip Calculator

A simple, offline tip calculator with a pixel-art aesthetic. Enter the bill amount, select a tip percentage (10%, 15%, or 20%), and set the number of people. The app calculates the tip amount and total per person.

## Features
- Bill amount input
- Tip percentage buttons (10%, 15%, 20%)
- Number of people input
- Real-time calculation of tip and total per person
- Responsive design (works from 360px wide)
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- No external dependencies or network requests

## Usage
Open `index.html` in any modern browser. The app works entirely offline.

## Files
- `index.html` – Main HTML structure
- `styles.css` – Styling and theme
- `script.js` – Calculation logic and interactivity
